repositories.name: open-code-review
repositories.description: Fast, efficient, battle-tested at Alibaba's scale. Hybrid architecture code review tool: deterministic pipelines + LLM Agent, precise line-level comments, built-in multi-language ruleset (NPE, thread-safety, XSS, SQL injection), OpenAI & Anthropic compatible.
repositories.summary: Open Code Review 是阿里巴巴开源的 AI 代码审查命令行工具，采用确定性流程与大模型 Agent 混合架构，可对代码变更做精确行级审查并内置多语言规则集。

repositories.name: colibri
repositories.description: Run frontier MoE models on hardware you already own — pure C, zero deps, experts streamed from disk. Tiny engine, immense model. 🐦
repositories.summary: Colibrì 是一个纯 C 编写、无依赖的推理引擎，通过将显存、内存和磁盘统一为分层存储，让普通消费级硬件也能运行 744B 至 2.8T 参数的前沿 MoE 大模型。

repositories.name: ever-gauzy
repositories.description: Ever® Gauzy™ - Open Business Management Platform (ERP/CRM/HRM/ATS/PM) - https://gauzy.co
repositories.summary: Ever Gauzy 是一个开源的企业管理平台，集成 ERP、CRM、HRM、项目与销售管理等模块，用于协作、按需和共享经济业务。

repositories.name: VoiceStudio
repositories.description: VoiceStudio is the open-source, fully-local ElevenLabs alternative — voice cloning, voice design, video dubbing, dictation, transcription & audiobook creation in 646 languages.
repositories.summary: VoiceStudio 是一个完全本地运行的开源语音工具，支持语音克隆、配音、听写、转录和有声书制作，覆盖 646 种语言。

repositories.name: BrewUI
repositories.summary: Homebrew 官方 macOS 图形界面，用 SwiftUI 让不熟悉命令行的用户也能发现、安装、更新和管理软件包，并透明展示底层操作。

repositories.name: DeskcommCRM
repositories.description: Open-source AI sales OS — self-hosted CRM with native AI agents + WhatsApp (WAHA). Open alternative to Kommo, Octadesk & Intercom for any business that sells by chat. MCP-ready, multi-tenant, LGPD.
repositories.summary: DeskcommCRM 是一款开源、可自托管的 AI 销售 CRM，内置 AI 智能体并通过 WhatsApp 接待、筛选和促成销售，面向以聊天成交的企业。

repositories.name: OpenResearch
repositories.description: Turn your coding agents into research agents
repositories.summary: OpenResearch 是一个本地优先的研究工作区，把 Claude Code、Codex 等编码代理变成可查阅文献、提出假设、运行实验并产出研究结果的研究代理。

repositories.name: ghidra
repositories.description: Ghidra is a software reverse engineering (SRE) framework
repositories.summary: Ghidra 是由美国国家安全局开发的软件逆向工程框架，提供反汇编、反编译、绘图和脚本等工具，用于分析多平台的已编译代码。

repositories.name: LibreChat
repositories.description: Enhanced ChatGPT Clone: Features Agents, MCP, Skills, DeepSeek, Anthropic, AWS, OpenAI, Responses API, Azure, Groq, o1, GPT-5, Mistral, OpenRouter, Vertex AI, Gemini, Artifacts, AI model switching, message search, Code Interpreter, langchain, DALL-E-3, OpenAPI Actions, Functions, Secure Multi-User Auth, Presets, open-source for self-hosting. Active
repositories.summary: LibreChat 是一个开源可自托管的 AI 聊天平台，在统一界面中接入 OpenAI、Anthropic、Google 等多种模型，支持多用户认证与自定义端点。

repositories.name: atlas
repositories.description: Source control for agents. Use multiple coding agents, track their changes and query them in one place
repositories.summary: Atlas 是用 Rust 编写的编码智能体版本控制工具，可同时运行多个编码智能体，集中记录并查询它们的改动与会话历史。

repositories.name: ASC
repositories.description: ASC is a super FAST Android decompiler front-end designed for Agents/Mobile Researchers.
repositories.summary: Droid ASC 是一个面向 Android 逆向的快速反编译前端，可直接查询 APK 字节码，按需提取并反编译目标类，支持跨 DEX 引用搜索。

repositories.name: agent-skills
repositories.description: Production-grade engineering skills for AI coding agents.
repositories.summary: 这是一套面向 AI 编程代理的工程技能包，用 Markdown 编写，覆盖需求、规划、编码、测试、评审到发布全流程，让代理按资深工程师的规范工作。

repositories.name: omniget
repositories.description: Download Udemy and Hotmart courses, YouTube videos, music and books — 1,800+ sites, no terminal. Free open-source desktop app for Windows, macOS and Linux, with a built-in course player, PDF/EPUB reader and music library. Powered by yt-dlp. Your files stay on your computer.
repositories.summary: OmniGet 是一款基于 yt-dlp 的免费开源桌面应用，可从 1800 多个网站下载课程、视频和音乐，并内置播放器与阅读器。

repositories.name: pi
repositories.description: AI agent toolkit: unified LLM API, agent loop, TUI, coding agent CLI
repositories.summary: Pi 是一个 TypeScript 编写的 AI 智能体工具包，提供统一 LLM API、智能体循环、终端界面和可自我扩展的编码智能体命令行工具。
